name: scientific-db-openalex-database
title: scientific-db-openalex-database
description: Concrete OpenAlex REST API workflows: cross-disciplinary literature search, DOI/PMID metadata resolution, open-access links, citation counts and reproducible search logs.
why: OpenAlex sits on the owner's own research-agent reading list, and nothing else in the collection speaks to a scholarly API — the research cluster has process skills but no literature-database playbook.
